findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/OfAssociative.lean:373 `LieAlgebra.ad_eq_lmul_left_sub_lmul_right (A) : (ad R A : A → Module.End R A) = LinearMap.mulLeft R - LinearMap.mulRight R` — the PR's body verbatim. `ad` at line 199; `ad_apply` (rfl) at 203; `of_associative_ring_bracket` at 57. The needed local instance is already used this way at code/EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LieAlgebra/Casimir.lean:97.
findings.fix: Add `attribute [local instance 100] LieRing.ofAssociativeRing` and define `colorAction N a := LieAlgebra.ad ℂ (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (genM N a)`, or drop the def and use `ad` directly. `colorAction_apply` is then `LieAlgebra.ad_apply` composed with `LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket`.
findings.issue: `colorAction N a := LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (genM N a) - LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (genM N a)` is Mathlib's adjoint action re-defined; it forgoes the whole `ad` API for a parallel one.

findings.evidence: code/EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LieAlgebra/Casimir.lean:105 `def casimir (b b' : ι → L) : Module.End R M := ∑ i, toEnd R L M (b i) * toEnd R L M (b' i)`, with `casimir_apply` at 115 and the explicit note at 68 that no basis/form hypothesis is built in. For `M = L = Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ`, `toEnd ℂ L L = LieAlgebra.ad ℂ L` (OfAssociative.lean:199-200), so this unfolds to `∑ a, ad(Tᵃ) * ad(Tᵃ)`. Instances resolve: `lieRingSelfModule`/`lieAlgebraSelfModule` are global (Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Basic.lean:176,185); the module is imported at EpsilonEridani.lean:16.
findings.fix: Delete `colorCasimir` and use `EpsilonEridani.LieModule.casimir ℂ (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) (genM N) (genM N)` (same local instance as above). `colorCasimir_apply`'s left-hand side is then supplied by `casimir_apply`.
findings.issue: `colorCasimir N := ∑ a, colorAction N a * colorAction N a` duplicates the repo's existing quadratic-Casimir definition, which is designed to take exactly such a family and is already in the root import.

findings.evidence: Line 111-112: `rw [colorOctetProj_eq, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply]` — nothing beyond the public `colorOctetProj_eq` plus two Mathlib simp lemmas.
findings.fix: Delete `colorOctetProj_apply_eq_sub`; callers get it from `simp [colorOctetProj_eq]`. If a simp-normal pointwise form is wanted, keep only one `@[simp]` apply-lemma for `colorOctetProj N ψ`.
findings.issue: `colorOctetProj_apply_eq_sub` is `colorOctetProj_eq` (line 100) applied pointwise — its proof is one `rw` of that lemma. It is also `@[simp]` while the other apply-lemma `colorOctetProj_apply` (line 94) is not, so simp always rewrites the generator form away.

summary: The colour projectors and their Fierz/trace content are genuinely new, but `colorAction` and `colorCasimir` are verbatim re-definitions of Mathlib's `LieAlgebra.ad` and of the repo's own `EpsilonEridani.LieModule.casimir`, creating a second adjoint-action/Casimir vocabulary. One restatement lemma also duplicates `colorOctetProj_eq`.
